articles.title: Tiny 1.7-Billion-Year-Old Fossils Solve a Big Mystery About Life
articles.summary: Scientists found 12,000 tiny fossils in old rock cores stored in a warehouse in Darwin, Australia. The fossils show that the earliest complex life needed oxygen to survive — just like us.

articles.title: Quantum Computer Makes Particles 'Pop Into Existence'
articles.summary: Scientists used a quantum computer to simulate a weird process where pulling particles apart creates new ones. It's like breaking a stretched string and watching new beads appear.

articles.title: A Giant Cosmic 'Fart' Is Making a Zombie Star Flash
articles.summary: A dead star 13,000 light-years away keeps flashing X-rays at Earth. Scientists discovered it's caused by a giant plume of gas from its partner star — basically a cosmic fart.
